changelog:
v2.0.0 — THE BIG ONE:

• Adrenaline Lock Guardian (wrong password → fullscreen jumpscare + intruder selfie, 4 themes: Water, Fire, Thunder, Void)
• 20 GPU live wallpapers (5 per family: Water, Fire, Galaxy, Cyber)
• 16 Power Tools: Flashlight+strobe, Compass, Battery Guard, RAM Cleaner, App Scanner, Weather, Step Counter, Eye Care, Find-My-Phone Siren, Voice FX, Sound Meter, Quick Dial, Alarms, Calendar, Location, Animation Scale
• Bulletproof deep-sleep engine: 1-min wake-lock heartbeat, exact Doze-piercing alarms, auto-restart on swipe/kill/reboot
• SIM Guard anti-theft: SIM change → siren + SMS alert to trusted number
• OTA self-updater with live manifest
• All permissions requested up-front

Install: allow 'Install unknown apps' for this app, tap the downloaded file, allow all permissions. If upgrading from v1.2.0, uninstall the old one first (new signing key).
